description: PHOENIX — SB 1066, introduced by Senator Wendy Rogers, would create real consequences for researchers who knowingly or recklessly publish fraudulent scientific research in Arizona. Scientific research is often used to guide public policy, medical decisions, education standards, and major spending choices. When that research is false or intentionally misleading, the damage can be serious and widespread. SB
title: SB 1066 Would Hold Researchers Accountable for Fraudulent Science | Wendy Rogers
